#### 10. galactosialidosis  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.434)

**Why it matters:** Understanding this shared mechanism of lysosomal dysfunction and ganglioside accumulation could inform therapeutic strategies targeting enzyme replacement, substrate reduction, or chaperone therapy for both Tay-Sachs disease and galactosialidosis, potentially leveraging shared development pipelines.
